2600.translation: Company count how many people visit its online shop each month. Visitors increase steadily from January reach March, but fall for first time for April. Person wey dey in charge analyse say growing complaints about late delivery na the cause. So company decide to begin by finding how to reduce delivery time.

2601.translation: Customer satisfaction survey report. This year satisfaction na 78 points, 4 points above last year 74. But this year, dem change how dem recruit respondents from telephone to online. Among online respondents, the share of people for their 20s and 30s become twice last year own. This age group also give above-average scores for earlier surveys. So current data no enough to tell how much of the rise come from real service improvement. We propose say next survey should compare results with age shares matched to last year.

2602.translation: Review of local small-business support programme. Average monthly sales for the thirty supported businesses rise 18 percent from before programme start. But by individual business, two businesses sales grow to more than three times, while twenty-one businesses sales reduce small. If dem remove these two, average growth rate fall well-well. Responsible department conclude say programme work overall, but these figures no give enough evidence for that conclusion.

2603.translation: Report on road safety for the area. This year traffic accidents na 1,200, up 6 percent from last year. But registered vehicles rise 11 percent for the same period. If dem calculate accidents per 10,000 vehicles, the rate actually fall. However, deaths remain around last year level. So e hard to claim say lower accident rate don also reduce serious accidents. Report recommend make dem interpret accident number and accident severity separately.

2604.translation: Research institute report say, over last five years, juvenile crime rate tend to fall for cities and counties wey get more libraries. But report no conclude say library expansion cause am. E also mention say both changes fit relate to area finances. Areas wey get plenty money no only increase libraries; dem increase after-school programmes too. Institute add say to confirm library expansion own effect, dem need compare areas wey get similar financial conditions.

2605.translation: Summary of citizen opinion survey. For this project, support na 62 percent, opposition na 31 percent, and no response na 7 percent. But response rate only 4 percent. Respondents wey be 65 or older na 52 percent, far above their actual population share of 24 percent. Research team also adjust figures to match real population age shares. After adjustment, support fall to 54 percent, but still pass opposition. Team say support still dey ahead, but the gap smaller than the original figures suggest.

2606.translation: Third-quarter operating results report. Net income na 12 billion won, about 35 percent above same period last year. But 2.5 billion won out of am na one-time gain from selling unused land. If dem remove that gain, net-income growth remain single digit. Operating profit, wey reflect core product-selling business, fall 2 percent. Finance team judge say e too early to take rising net income as sign say business dey improve. Dem go review this judgment after checking whether the same pattern repeat next quarter.

2607.translation: Monthly housing-market report. Apartment transactions for capital region rise 3 percent from previous month. But for the last three months overall, e mostly remain flat. Price index rise only 0.2 percent, wey fit fall inside margin of error. Estate agents dey report more enquiries after loan interest rate cut, but transaction statistics never confirm this. So report judge say e too early to conclude say market don enter recovery.

2608.translation: Research institute survey 1,200 office workers. People wey work from home at least two times every week give average job satisfaction of 78 points, above office-based workers 65. Institute announce from this say work-from-home raise productivity. But survey only ask people to rate their own satisfaction; e no measure actual output. Also, work-from-home participants mostly dey jobs wey allow plenty freedom. So e hard to tell whether satisfaction gap come from work arrangement or job type. These results alone no enough to conclude say work-from-home raise productivity.

2609.translation: Average share of income wey households spend on housing na 22 percent, same as five years ago. Some people use am talk say housing burden never change. But for lowest-income 20 percent of households, the share rise from 31 to 38 percent. For highest-income 20 percent, e fall from 15 to 12 percent. One side rise, the other fall; dem cancel each other, so average remain same. Average fit show centre of the whole, but e no show changes between groups. Same average no mean every household burden remain same.

2610.translation: For Hansol Library first year after opening, visitors increase 40 percent compared with previous year. City judge say citizens reading culture don spread. But books wey people borrow increase only 3 percent. For user survey, majority say dem visit to study for reading room. Visitor count fit show access and comfort of facility, but no directly show how much people dey read. To claim say reading culture spread, dem need other indicators too, like books borrowed and reading time.

2611.translation: Official consumer-price increase this year na 2.1 percent, but plenty citizens feel say living cost rise much more. Some criticise statistics say e distort reality. But price index dey assign item weights from average household spending pattern. If food prices rise 5 percent, low-income households wey spend plenty on food normally go feel increase above average. So gap between official rate and people experience fit come from one number wey no represent every household, rather than wrong calculation.

2612.translation: For three months after advertising begin for June, new drink sales increase 20 percent compared with previous three months. Marketing team present graph as evidence say advertisement work. But this drink demand dey rise for summer. Even last year without advertising, sales rise 18 percent for same period. On that basis, passage estimate advertisement contribution at most around 2 percentage points. But weather and competing products fit differ between the two years, so even that figure no be confirmed effect.

2613.translation: Online shop survey find say 35 percent of respondents choose very dissatisfied. Some executives think say service don get serious problem. But only 12 percent of invited people respond, and customers wey get complaints tend to respond more. So dem no fit read 35 percent as all customers judgment. Still, data no useless. Reasons wey respondents give for dissatisfaction fit show which areas dem should improve first.

2614.translation: Average score of students wey skip breakfast dey 6 points below students wey chop am. People often use this claim say breakfast raise school achievement. But when dem compare students from households with similar income, gap reduce to 1.5 points. Lower-income students more likely to skip breakfast and also face worse study conditions. This analysis no mean breakfast get no effect at all. But e show clear say other factors explain plenty of the original gap.

2615.translation: The smaller the sample, the larger result error normally dey.

2616.translation: Nearly half of respondents say dem value quality pass price.

2617.translation: Even though income rise, savings rate turn out to fall instead.

2640.translation: Work plenty this week, so e be like say I need do overtime.

2641.translation: You fit contact me by messenger even when I dey work from home.

2642.translation: Urgent matter don happen, so e be like say I no fit attend meeting.

2643.translation: I go contact you after I report to department manager.

2644.translation: Sales this quarter pass target by 10 percent.

2645.translation: Abeg, check conditions again before you sign contract.

2646.translation: People receive new product well, so orders double.

2648.translation: I forget to attach file to email.

2649.translation: A: Assistant Manager, abeg you fit check tomorrow business-trip schedule? B: Yes, you dey take nine o'clock morning flight to Busan. A: Wetin time client meeting be? B: Na two for afternoon, and I don email you meeting materials.
